course.title: Makeup Artistry
course.tagline: Do flawless makeup for every skin tone: skin prep, glam looks and bridal-ready finishes.

days.title: Welcome to Makeup Artistry
days.goal: By the end of today you can explain and practise: Your kit is brushes, sponges, primers, foundations, concealers, powders and setting spray.

video.title: How to Apply Makeup Step by Step: Full-Face Tutorial

steps: Get your tools ready: beauty sponge, foundation brush and eyeshadow brush.
Watch the video. It explains the main point in simple steps: A damp beauty sponge blends foundation seamlessly.
Your kit is brushes, sponges, primers, foundations, concealers, powders and setting spray. Go slowly. Practise on a model or a practice head.
Do the same move three times. Check your work in a mirror or a photo after each try.
Write down what went well, what was hard, and one thing to do better tomorrow.
days.task: Practise welcome to makeup artistry on a model or a practice head. Your kit is brushes, sponges, primers, foundations, concealers, powders and setting spray. Take a photo of your work.
days.challenge: Do welcome to makeup artistry two times today. Make the second try neater than the first.

quiz.q: What is the key point of today's lesson on welcome to makeup artistry?
options: You should rush through the technique to save time.
A damp beauty sponge blends foundation seamlessly.
The best result comes from skipping the preparation step.
You never need to check your work until the very end.
quiz.explain: A damp beauty sponge blends foundation seamlessly.

quiz.q: Which tool is most essential for welcome to makeup artistry?
quiz.explain: The beauty sponge is the essential tool for this work.

quiz.q: What should you always do when working on welcome to makeup artistry?
options: check the client for cuts before starting
quiz.explain: Never double-dip mascara wands.

days.title: Hygiene and Brush Care
days.goal: By the end of today you can explain and practise: Wash brushes weekly, use clean sponges per client, and never double-dip mascara.

video.title: 10 Step Flawless Everyday Makeup Tutorial for Beginners

steps: Get your tools ready: beauty sponge, foundation brush and eyeshadow brush.
Watch the video. It explains the main point in simple steps: Mascara wands must never be double-dipped into the tube.
Wash brushes weekly, use clean sponges per client, and never double-dip mascara. Go slowly. Practise on a model or a practice head.
Do the same move three times. Check your work in a mirror or a photo after each try.
Write down what went well, what was hard, and one thing to do better tomorrow.

quiz.q: What is the key point of today's lesson on hygiene and brush care?
options: The best result comes from skipping the preparation step.
You never need to check your work until the very end.
Mascara wands must never be double-dipped into the tube.
Using dirty tools gives the same result as clean ones.
quiz.explain: Mascara wands must never be double-dipped into the tube.

quiz.q: Which tool is most essential for hygiene and brush care?

quiz.q: What should you always do when working on hygiene and brush care?
